messages:
anya: Drafting a short playbook for migrating tenants off pinned models with minimal disruption. posting for quick ops + product feedback.
chet: Appreciate it. Key risks we should call out: cost spike, latency regressions, contractual pin exemptions.
mira: Suggest a four-stage plan: 1) instrumentation + shadow sampling, 2) internal pilot (3 tenants), 3) external canary (5 tenants), 4) opt-in wave + full roll.
anya: Instrumentation: add model_version & rollout_id headers to traces, store audit rows for 90 days. also a per-tenant sampling slider (API + Console).
chet: Gate matrix proposal: correctness delta <= 0.5% (tenant golden set), p95 latency change <= 30ms, compute cost delta <= 10%, zero new safety hits. fail -> rollback.
mira: Rollback mechanics: route override API: POST /tenants/{id}/route_override {model_version, reason}. flip route, purge caches, run quick golden-set check.
anya: Sampling defaults: canary tenants 100% shadow; broad population 10% by default, configurable per-tenant. add global soft-budget that pauses shadows when spend delta > threshold.
chet: Monitoring: nightly diff job that emits: mismatch_rate, avg_confidence_delta, latency_delta, token_cost_diff, top-20 failing prompts. surface in Console + weekly digest to #product.
mira: UX: Migration tab showing per-tenant health (pass/warn/fail), sampling slider, opt-in toggle, export CSV for "pinned-exceptions". include FAQ about contractual pins.
devops-bot: Deploy bot: pipeline created project/model-migrations/1747015000-runner
anya: Timeline: start internal pilot next Wed (7d), review, then 48-72h external canaries, then 2-week opt-in window.
chet: Add auto-pause: if per-tenant compute cost delta > tenant_threshold -> pause migration + notify billing/product.
mira: Success metrics after rollout: no regression incidents >1/week, median p95 latency within 10% of baseline, adoption >= 70% at 8 weeks.
anya: I'll convert this thread into an RFC + runbook and assign owners. thanks for feedback.
